result.text:
### Q1
No, keep the plain-JSON file store (no SQLite). Ops backs up `data/store.json` with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain text, and a binary DB would break those checks. Instead, writes are debounced (200 ms) with a flush on shutdown.

### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/` must not be modified. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so any change would be silently lost.

### Q3
The signature goes in the JSON body as a top-level `sig` field. It is the hex HMAC-SHA256 over the body without `sig`, using `ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. I first put it in an `X-Signature` header, but the ERP's API gateway strips custom X- headers, so the ERP saw everything as unsigned.

### Q4
Port 9911, since the October infra move. `docs/erp-api.md` and the README still say 8080, and `config/default.json` still points to 8080.

### Q5
Every new user-facing error `message` must be German, because the staff UI shows it verbatim to packers. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

### Q6
Austrian public holidays for 2026 and 2027 are hardcoded in `src/services/holidays.ts`, and `isBusinessDay` in `eta.ts` consults them. They are hardcoded because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet, so it must work fully offline. The list needs extending before 2028.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to any array payload and accepts only one event object per request, as the user found when they tried batching in September.

### Q8
No new npm packages, runtime or dev. Each one needs a security review that takes about six weeks.

### Q9
Not built by me. The user had tried it and QA found a stale-ETA bug (the list kept the old ETA after a new event, and the cache key got messy), so it's a dead end. My benchmark also showed ETA costs only about 0.35 ms per 50 items. I added a regression test, and pagination of the list comes later.

### Q10
Three attempts in total with a fixed 30 s delay and no exponential backoff, and the delay is injectable for tests. The ERP deduplicates by `event_id` only within a 2-minute window, so all attempts must land inside it. Retries apply to network errors and 5xx responses, not 4xx.

### Q11
Never log the recipient's name, address or phone number, in any log call, because of GDPR (flagged by the data protection officer in the audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.

### Q12
Yes, "emits webhook on delivered" in `test/events.test.ts` (a timer race, about 1 in 5, tracked as OPS-412 and owned by the platform team). If it fails, rerun once and don't try to fix it.

### Q13
ATP numbers must be valid UPU S10, including the check digit (per `docs/carriers.md`). All other carriers accept any non-empty value, because their formats change often and valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for two days last year.

### Q14
`fs.watch` never fires on staging, because the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host and change events don't propagate into the container. `fs.watchFile` (polling) worked. Nothing has been built yet, so if hot reload is ever implemented, use polling.

### Q15
Yes, `GET /shipments/:id`. The mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema, so no fields may be added, removed or renamed. The next mobile release is in January. `eta` goes only into the `GET /shipments` list items.
